title: Octopuses have three hearts, and one of them quits when it swims

scenes.speaker: dave
scenes.text: Hang on. Octopuses have three hearts? What does it need three for, a love triangle?

scenes.speaker: nibbles
scenes.text: Two of them pump blood through the gills, Dave. The third pumps it around the body.

scenes.speaker: dave
scenes.text: So it's got a spare. Like me with kebabs.

scenes.speaker: nibbles
scenes.text: Not quite. That third heart actually stops beating when the octopus swims.

scenes.speaker: dave
scenes.text: It stops? Mate, that's how I feel after the stairs.

scenes.speaker: nibbles
scenes.text: Which is exactly why octopuses prefer crawling. Swimming wears them out.

scenes.speaker: dave
scenes.text: Finally, an animal that gets me. What else has it got?

scenes.speaker: nibbles
scenes.text: Blue blood. It carries oxygen using copper, not iron like ours.

scenes.speaker: dave
scenes.text: Blue blood? So it's posh. Like you, but wetter.

scenes.speaker: nibbles
scenes.text: Charming. Also, most of its brain cells are in its eight arms, not its head.

scenes.speaker: dave
scenes.text: So its arms are smarter than its head? Nibbles, I think I'm part octopus.

scenes.speaker: nibbles
scenes.text: Dave, your arms couldn't open a crisp packet yesterday.

scenes.speaker: dave
scenes.text: That packet was rigged. Anyway, why does it have three hearts again?

description: Three hearts, blue blood and arms that think for themselves: Big Dave and Professor Nibbles on the strangest animal in the sea.
